info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Asset API
Microsoft Azure Query The List Of Assets In A Workspace

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The Azure Subscription ID.

params.name: resourceGroup
params.description: The Name of the resource group in which the workspace is located.

params.name: workspace
params.description: The name of the workspace.

params.name: runId
params.description: The run Id associated with the Assets.

params.name: name
params.description: The object name.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of items to retrieve in a page.

params.name: $skipToken
params.description: The continuation token to retrieve the next page.

params.name: tags
params.description:
A set of tags with which to filter the returned models.
            It is a comma separated string of tags key or tags key=value
            Example: tagKey1,tagKey2,tagKey3=value3

params.name: properties
params.description:
A set of properties with which to filter the returned models.
            It is a comma separated string of properties key and/or properties key=value
            Example: propKey1,propKey2,propKey3=value3

params.name: orderby
params.description: An option for specifying how to order the list.

items.docs: If no filter is passed, the query lists all the Assets in the given workspace. The returned list is paginated and the count of items in each page is an optional parameter.
